property: The consolidated SMTP transport standard is formally revised while retaining the textual command/reply and mail-envelope transport lineage.

date_or_range.notes: RFC 5321 obsoletes RFC 2821 and consolidates earlier mail-transport material.

sources.supports: formal successor relationship and continuing basic Internet mail-transport role

negative_claims: SMTP transport is not the same artifact as RFC 5322 message format.
This edge does not claim that every SMTP extension originated in RFC 2821.
open_questions: Build RFC 821→2821→5321 command/reply and state-machine diff.
Map ESMTP extensions as branches rather than core-version replacements.
notes: Transport-document revision lineage remains separate from message-format and mailbox-access lineages.
